views.name: variant_stock
views.definition:
SELECT id AS variant_id,
        CASE
            WHEN tracking_mode = 'serialized'::text THEN ( SELECT count(*) AS count
               FROM inventory_units u
                 JOIN inventory_lots l ON l.id = u.lot_id
              WHERE l.variant_id = v.id AND u.custody_status = 'available'::text AND u.condition_status = 'new'::text)
            ELSE COALESCE(( SELECT sum(l.qty_on_hand - l.qty_reserved) AS sum
               FROM inventory_lots l
              WHERE l.variant_id = v.id), 0::bigint)
        END AS available
   FROM product_variants v;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_promotion_target()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$ DECLARE oldid uuid; newid uuid; BEGIN
 IF TG_OP<>'INSERT' THEN oldid:=OLD.promotion_version_id; END IF; IF TG_OP<>'DELETE' THEN newid:=NEW.promotion_version_id; END IF;
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM promotion_redemptions WHERE promotion_version_id IN(oldid,newid)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'USED_PROMOTION_TARGET_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF; RETURN CASE WHEN TG_OP='DELETE' THEN OLD ELSE NEW END;
END $function$

functions.definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.guard_quarantine_source()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$ BEGIN
 IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inventory_allocations WHERE order_item_unit_amount_id=NEW.order_item_unit_amount_id AND lot_id=NEW.lot_id) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'QUARANTINE_WRONG_SOURCE' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF;
 IF TG_OP='UPDATE' AND ROW(OLD.order_item_unit_amount_id,OLD.lot_id,OLD.quantity) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.order_item_unit_amount_id,NEW.lot_id,NEW.quantity) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'QUARANTINE_SOURCE_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF; RETURN NEW;
END $function$

 IF TG_OP='DELETE' OR OLD.status IN ('completed','failed') OR ROW(NEW.order_id,NEW.credit_note_id,NEW.amount_vnd,NEW.approved_by,NEW.idempotency_key) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(OLD.order_id,OLD.credit_note_id,OLD.amount_vnd,OLD.approved_by,OLD.idempotency_key) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'REFUND_IMMUTABLE' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF; RETURN NEW;
END $function$
